authority_boundary.operator: determines mission direction and authorizes external or destructive mutations
authority_boundary.apex_control_plane: binds execution intent, route policy, verification requirements, and receipts
authority_boundary.source_system: retains authority for provider-native source bytes, identity, execution state, and delivery receipts
authority_boundary.compute_fabric: selects an eligible verified backend without acquiring project authority
authority_boundary.connector_worker_fabric: executes provider-native event, sync, inventory, and mutation work under connector policy

compute_fabric.purpose: route declared compute workloads to an eligible verified backend

buildkite_verified_execution.purpose: private CI, deterministic validation, and other workloads proven on Buildkite

connector_worker_fabric.purpose: provider-native sync, webhook, polling, inventory, and mutation work

private_github_actions_exception.purpose: temporary compatibility or narrowly justified private GitHub-hosted execution

none.purpose: artifact has no active execution requirement

dynamic_workload_state.reason: workload migration status is time-varying source-bearing state and must be supplied by the live control plane rather than fossilized in this policy
